product_catalog/sample.text: Actual sample: R1 recorder+A1 adapter, tested successfully with balanced XLR microphone. Bare R1 was not tested; this does not prove every input. A1 is physically made for R1 port.

product_catalog/retail.text: CurrentDay1 official R1 complete kit includes R1+A1. A1 is required for the tested XLR chain. Nothing here verifies a bare recorder or future successor.

product_catalog/successor.text: Official issuedDay2 10:00: current retail becomes R2+A1 box. R2 has a changed port: A1 does not mate to it; TRS input requires separate A2. A2 is not included. Existing R1+A1 XLR equipment is unchanged.

product_catalog/test.text: ActualDay3 09:00 test: R2+A2 with TRS input worked. R2+A1 box was not a working chain; A2 remains separate and is not added to retail contents by this result.
